answer: A farm emitting 105 variations of one paragraph hence pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the beacon panel. Because the entropy is measured at the spiral gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the violet audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 3 bits per word is rejected before grading, as it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 19 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
